text.t:
Delicately crafted from pine plywood, these bowls inspired by gingerbread cookies and marshmallow bowls are personalised with an acrylic name or the inscription Merry Christmas.
The red thread, small gold accents and the delicate bell add a festive and cosy touch, making each piece unique and full of charm.
A piece designed to decorate the Christmas tree and celebrate the magic of the little details.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: It is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
